title: Screening Autism Spectrum Disorder in children using Deep Learning Approach : Evaluating the classification model of YOLOv26s by comparing with other models
abstract: arXiv:2306.14300v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a developmental condition that presents significant challenges in social interac- tion, communication, and behavior. Early intervention plays a pivotal role in enhancing cognitive abilities and reducing autistic symptoms in children with ASD. Numerous clinical studies have highlighted distinctive facial characteristics that distinguish ASD children from typically developing (TD) children. In this study, we propose a practical solution for ASD screening using facial images using YOLOv26s model. By employing YOLOv26s, a deep learning technique, we achieved exceptional results. Our model achieved a remarkable 92.86% accuracy in classification and an F1-score of 0.9291. Our findings provide support for the clini- cal observations regarding facial feature discrepancies between children with ASD. translated_title: 基于深度学习方法筛查儿童自闭症谱系障碍：通过与其他模型比较评估YOLOv26s分类模型
translated_abstract: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种发育性疾病，在社交互动、沟通和行为方面带来显著挑战。早期干预在提升ASD儿童的认知能力和减少自闭症症状方面起着关键作用。众多临床研究强调了区分ASD儿童与典型发育（TD）儿童的独特面部特征。在本研究中，我们提出了一种使用YOLOv26s模型基于面部图像进行ASD筛查的实用解决方案。通过采用深度学习技术YOLOv26s，我们取得了卓越的结果。我们的模型在分类上达到了92.86%的准确率，F1分数为0.9291。我们的研究结果为关于ASD儿童面部特征差异的临床观察提供了支持。所获得的高F1分数证明了深度学习模型在筛查儿童ASD方面的潜力。
tldr: 本研究利用YOLOv26s深度学习模型基于面部图像筛查儿童自闭症，达到92.86%的准确率和0.9291的F1分数，验证了面部特征差异的临床观察。
en_tdlr: This study uses the YOLOv26s deep learning model to screen children with autism based on facial images, achieving 92.86% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.9291, supporting clinical observations of facial feature differences.
